description_en: Queries all the tags of a resource
description_zh: 获取指定资源所有的标签信息
kebab_example: aliyun fc-open get-resource-tags --resource-arn acs:fc:cn-shanghai:1880770869020000:services/demo --x-fc-account-id 1880770869020000 --x-fc-date Wed,_11_May_2022_09:00:00_GMT --x-fc-trace-id my-test-trace-id --api-version 2021-04-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetResourceTags

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the resource.

>  You can use the value of this parameter to query information about the resource, such as the account, service, and region of the resource. You can manage tags only for services for top level resources
parameters.help_zh:
阿里云资源的标识。
> 您可以通过此参数确认该资源所属的账号、服务、地域等。目前只能给Top Level资源的服务进行标签的相关操作
parameters.name: resource_arn

parameters.help_en: The ID of your Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 您的阿里云账号（主账号）ID
parameters.name: x_fc_account_id

parameters.help_en: The time when the function is invoked. The value is in the **EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT** format
parameters.help_zh: 函数的调用开始日期，格式为**EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT**
parameters.name: x_fc_date
